<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate initially and continue cooperating unless the opponent defects twice consecutively. This preserves mutual cooperation with cooperative and retaliatory opponents while avoiding permanent retaliation after a single probing or accidental-looking defection.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 1 if len(opponent_history) > 1 and opponent_history[-1] == 1 and opponent_history[-2] == 1 else 0
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
